mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 inducer that may increase ibuprofen metabolism; concurrent use of NSAIDs with antiepileptic drugs increases seizure risk and gastrointestinal/renal complications.
action: Monitor seizure control and consider alternative analgesia; if ibuprofen necessary, use lowest effective dose with gastroprotection and monitor renal function.
